notes:
Account snapshot and recent timeline:
- Summary: Crimson Harbor Assist (CHA) builds a customer support platform used by mid-market telco + fintech customers. Primary initiative: reduce live agent load via RAG-based ticket deflection and an answer bot integrated into web + chat. Looking for embeddings + reranking flow: dense ANN to generate ~200 candidates then rerank to top-5, target top-5 precision > 88-90%.
- Scale: expected index size 20-35M documents (KBs, tickets, product docs), ingestion rate ~50-100k docs/month in steady state. Concern: index growth and snapshot/replica sizing.
- Latency SLOs: target p95 end-to-end retrieval+rerank <= 120ms for web widget (internal ask: p95 <= 75-100ms for premium customers). Must support geo-routing to NA + EU with data residency for EU customers.
- Cost sensitivity: wants cost per query baseline for hosted vs dedicated. Internal target: ~$0.0015 - $0.003 per query (including embedding + ANN + rerank); procurement will push back above $0.005.
- Architecture preferences: hybrid sparse+dense retrieval to filter initial candidate set (sparse for recall), ANN for dense, then lightweight reranker (2-3B reranker OK). Interested in automatic batching, prefix caching, and quantized models to hit latency/cost goals.
- Security/compliance: SOC2 required, SSO/SAML, audit logs for queries, KMS-managed keys, legal requires EU data residency for certain customers. Wants proof points for private deployment (VPC) and a support SLA.
- POC status: POC underway on Dedicated (reserved pool) using 8x A10G equivalent; bench results 2026-02-22 meeting: ANN recall@100 = 0.86 with HNSW tuned, initial reranker improved top-5 precision to 0.87. Bottleneck observed in CPU-bound batching during rerank stage.
- Actions and timeline (bulleted):
  * 2026-01-12 intro call (ff_2026-01-12_1203) — AE + SE + product — scoped index size + SLOs.
  * 2026-02-05 security Q&A — sent security deck (drive link).
  * 2026-02-22 POC kickoff — supplied test dataset (50k tickets + KB snapshot). Bench run 1 complete; shared logs (SUP-1423).
  * 2026-02-28 perf run 2 — measured retrieval+rerank median 48ms, p95 190ms (reranker hot-path CPU + batching issue).
  * 2026-03-03 deep-dive with SE (Priya) — suggested 1) reduce reranker candidate set via better ANN tuning, 2) offload reranker to GPU-optimized path, 3) enable KV-prefix cache for recent queries.
  * 2026-03-08 follow-up — CHA requested cost model comparing Hosted vs Dedicated (30M doc index, 100M queries/month).
- Direct quotes / call snippets:
  * "We can accept some precision loss at recall 100, but top-5 must feel like an agent answer." — Head of Product (CHA).
  * "Procurement will kill this if we can't show < $0.003 per query across monthly volume." — VP Ops.
- Open technical risks: reranker CPU bottleneck, index snapshot/replica plan for multi-region serving, secure transfer for on-prem customer subsets.
- Next immediate steps: finish tuned ANN + smaller candidate rerank (by 2026-03-12), run GPU-reranker experiment (3-day), deliver cost-per-query model and a sample SLA page for Dedicated offering.
- Sales/contract notes: procurement prefers 12-month committed usage; initial deal ask ~100k ARR but potential expansion if SLA + residency are satisfied. Forecast slotted for 2026-04.
